comments: 4d786884: This section of the code is responsible for viewing Deficiency Records.
14d8f729: Set up the environment for viewing deficiency records and then call the main view routine.
e3beb76f: Prepare prefix for 'Date Coded' field, indicating mandatory if not in view mode.
b29465cb: Reset local variable X to an empty string.
6a81d4cd: Set 'Date Coded' label into the display buffer.
323e192c: Convert internal date to external format for display.
acf4ce83: Place formatted 'Date Coded' into the temporary global for display.
d11f7f24: End of the 'Date Coded' section.
e9c9ea66: Prepare prefix for 'Coded By' field, indicating mandatory if not in view mode.
a59222f8: Clear the X variable for fresh use.
ba38e5dc: Set 'Coded By' label into the display buffer.
c77429c2: Retrieve name of the coder from the file and set it for display.
d19c99cb: Place formatted 'Coded By' into the temporary global for display.
9fe9ab95: End of the 'Coded By' section.
439d5ef7: Extract and format the ICD diagnosis code for display.
1e2483c2: End of the helper function used for extracting ICD diagnosis codes.
ed93939f: This section of the code handles the display of comments associated with a deficiency record.
c938f4b8: Clear the X variable for use.
e4acc40c: Initialize the display line for comments section.
a00d86b2: Reset X to prepare for the next line of display.
6f14c5ad: Set 'Comments:' label into the display buffer.
6a38b8ef: Retrieve the comment text from the deficiency record.
0f893da5: Display the first part of the comments.
c04c3c28: Clear X to prepare for the continuation of comments.
52a90fd1: Display the next segment of the comments if it exists.
ed157361: Reset X for the next line of comment display.
32d161ab: Display the third segment of the comments if it exists.
f6159b80: Clear X to prepare for the final segment of the comments.
356eda23: Display the last segment of the comments if it exists.
7f36f1e8: End of the comments section processing.
9c2affe0:  ;This block of code determines the status of a document based on various conditions.
01b13327: ;Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if signed flag and review dates are missing.
28c41a9c: ;Set status to 'REVIEWED' if signed flag is missing but review date is present.
7ae4891c: ;Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if signed flag is present, review date is missing, and deletion flag is 0.
478a407c: ;Set status to 'SIGNED' if signed flag is present, review date is missing, and deletion flag is 1.
fa5f6172: ;Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if the initial date is missing.
e6d6bb86: ;Set status to 'DICTATED' if the dictated date is missing.
5729faec: ;Set status to 'TRANSCRIBED' if the transcription date is missing.
b8a32b27: ;Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if deletion flag is 0.
ed1cd8d5: ;Set status to 'SIGNED' if the review date is missing.
39656c88: ;Set status to 'REVIEWED' if deletion flag is 1.
d47f47c3: ;Updates the document status in the database and clears variables.
0a2867c8: ;End of the routine.
